guideline: Principles of Human Evaluation for LLaVABench: 1. Correctness: Assess whether responses address the key points outlined in the reference answer and image. 2. Faithfulness: Examine any additional information in the answer to verify its accuracy and relevance. 3. Coherence: Evaluate the fluency and coherence of the responses
